+## 2026-07-30 bug fix: duplicate-highlight visual aid never reached the user
+
+Code review found that `DeduplicateEncounters.MarkDuplicateEncounters` (CLAUDE.md
+Step 4 / process flow doc item 5 -- "highlight duplicate encounter numbers in
+red... a visual aid so staff can see at a glance which encounters had more
+than one FC ID") had no effect the user could ever see:
+
+- It colours cells on `wsA` (the File A workbook opened via the file picker),
+  but `MainMacro.GenerateFCCompletionReport` closes that workbook with
+  `SaveChanges:=False` at the end of the run.
+- `BuildOutputWorkbook` builds the EM/EL sheets by reading `fileAws` into a
+  plain `Variant` array (`.Value`) and writing that array into new sheets --
+  this copies values only, never cell formatting, so even if `wsA` had been
+  left open, the red fill would not have propagated to the deliverable.
+
+Net effect: the highlighting was computed and then thrown away every run --
+staff had no way to see, in the actual output workbook, which surviving rows
+had duplicate FC IDs resolved out from under them.
+
+**Fix** -- moved the visual aid to the sheets staff actually receive:
+- `DeduplicateEncounters.ResolveDuplicateEncounters` gained a new `ByRef
+  resolvedEncounters As Object` out-parameter: a Dictionary keyed by Encounter
+  Number for every encounter that had more than one row before resolution
+  (populated at the same point `duplicateGroupsResolved` is incremented).
+- `MainMacro.GenerateFCCompletionReport` threads this dictionary from
+  `ResolveDuplicateEncounters` straight through to `BuildOutputWorkbook`.
+- `BuildOutput.BuildOutputWorkbook` gained a matching `resolvedEncounters As
+  Object` parameter, a new "Duplicate(s) Resolved" column (Yes/blank, same
+  pattern as "CCF Closed By"/"Looks Wrong"/"NCID Ward"), and a new
+  `HighlightResolvedDuplicateRows` sub (modelled on the existing
+  `HighlightCCFFallbackRows`) that red-fills the Encounter Number cell on the
+  EM/EL sheets for every row flagged "Yes" -- called right after
+  `WriteFilteredFileASheet` for both `wsEM` and `wsEL`.
+
+Applied to both `DeduplicateEncounters.bas`/`MainMacro.bas`/`BuildOutput.bas`
+and their mirror in `FCCompletion_All_Modules.txt` (verified byte-identical
+after the edit). **Needs user re-compile** (Alt+F11 -> Debug -> Compile
+VBAProject) -- not yet tested against a real export.
+
+---
+
+## 2026-07-30 Summary restructure + native charts
+
+Restructured the Summary sheet so the status breakdown leads, and added six
+native Excel charts (two on Summary, four on a new Analytics sheet).
+
+### New modules
+- `ChartHelpers.bas` -- band colour constants (shared with `BuildOutput.bas`'s
+  table fills, so a table cell and its chart segment can never disagree),
+  `EnsureChartDataSheet` (the single very-hidden `ChartData` sheet every
+  chart's contiguous source range lives on), `AddChartFromBlock` (one
+  reusable, `On Error`-guarded chart-creation helper used by every chart).
+- `Analytics.bas` -- new `Analytics` sheet: Point-of-Care ward gap (Chart 3),
+  day-of-week EM completion rate (Chart 4), EM turnaround distribution
+  (Chart 5, admission -> 1st CCF Creation Date-Time), EL lead-time vs.
+  completion (Chart 6, admission minus 1st CCF Creation Date-Time in days,
+  including a deliberately-not-hidden "No CCF created" bucket at 0%).
+
+### `BuildOutput.bas` changes
+- `WriteSummaryBlock`'s six band fill colours now reference `ChartHelpers`
+  constants instead of literal `RGB(...)` calls -- this **changed** three
+  colours to match the chart segments exactly: Pink from `RGB(255,192,203)`
+  to `RGB(255,199,206)`, Draft only from white/no-fill to `RGB(242,242,242)`,
+  Voided only from no-fill to `RGB(217,217,217)`, Missed FC from
+  `RGB(217,217,217)` to `RGB(166,166,166)`.
+- `WriteSummarySheet` reordered: title -> new headline block (EM/EL/Combined
+  denominator + completed count + completed %, "completed" = Green + Pink +
+  Light Green, the existing complement of "Not completed (total)") -> Chart 1
+  anchor -> status tables (unchanged content) -> Chart 2 anchor -> warnings
+  block -> reconciliation waterfall (moved from the top; heading "Reconciliation
+  -- for checking, not for the meeting"). Gained two `ByRef Long` out-params,
+  `chart1AnchorRow`/`chart2AnchorRow`.
+- `BuildOutputWorkbook`'s main per-row pass now captures `priArr()` (the FC
+  status priority already computed per row) so `Analytics.bas` reuses the
+  exact same numbers the Summary tables were built from, instead of
+  recomputing -- a chart and its table can never drift apart. Also resolves
+  three new columns (`Admission Date` was already resolved elsewhere; new:
+  `1st CCF Creation Date-Time`, `Latest CCF Creation Date-Time`), and creates
+  the new Analytics sheet after Staff Roster Check.
+- `AddSheet` changed from `Private` to `Public` so `Analytics.bas` can reuse it.
+
+### Column reference fix (CLAUDE.md)
+`1st CCF ETBS`/`Latest CCF ETBS` are currency (dollar amounts), not
+timestamps -- an earlier version of CLAUDE.md's column reference conflated
+"AY: Latest CCF ETBS" with the real timestamp column. Corrected: `AT` = 1st
+CCF Creation Date-Time, `AX` = Latest CCF Creation Date-Time, `AY` = Latest
+CCF LOS, `AZ` = Latest CCF ETBS (dollars). Turnaround/lead-time calculations
+use AT/AX exclusively, resolved by header text as always.
+
+### Chart failure handling
+Every chart is created via `ChartHelpers.AddChartFromBlock`, which is
+guarded with `On Error` and returns `Nothing` on any failure. Every call
+site checks for `Nothing` and writes a one-line note on the sheet instead --
+a charting failure never aborts report generation. The tables remain the
+deliverable; charts are presentation.
